claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No existing EffectAtom represents creating a permanent adhesive bond between two objects. The effect is not damage, condition, movement, resistance, speed, sensing, or any other existing atom category. It is a permanent physical joining of two discrete objects that persists until broken by specific means.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.bond_objects — breaking condition predicate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bond is breakable only by named specific items or a named spell. This 'only broken by X' qualifier is a new constraint shape on an effect — distinct from duration (permanent vs. timed) and from negate_named_effect (which negates spells, not bonds). A breakable-by-item/spell field on bond_objects would capture this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityHeader.activationDelay
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Utilize action starts the application but the effect (bond) does not take hold for 1 minute. The current surface has no field for a post-activation delay window before the effect resolves. This differs from duration (which describes how long an effect persists after taking hold), and differs from CastingTime.minutes (which is the full cast time, not a two-phase apply-then-set sequence).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set.
